component.name: SqlQueryStress
component.summary: A cross-platform SQL Server benchmarking tool

description.p: SqlQueryStress is a cross-platform SQL Server benchmarking tool that lets you stress-test T-SQL queries with configurable concurrency, iterations, and parameter substitution. It is an Avalonia port of the original Windows-only SqlQueryStress application.

ul.li: Multi-threaded query execution with configurable iterations
Parameter substitution for data-driven load testing
SQL Server statistics collection (IO and TIME)
Buffer and cache management for reproducible results
Benchmark export to text, CSV, or clipboard
